name: Solenne
summary: A frosted-glass smart home that lives by the sun: scrub the day, routines, solar and battery
about: A complete smart-home control app for one house, in milky glass by day and smoked glass by night, under a sky that moves. Drag the time-of-day scrubber and the sun travels, the sky behind the whole app changes colour and the house windows light up as each routine would run. Routines sit on a draggable 24-hour timeline, and the energy page follows rooftop solar and a home battery. Good for a smart-home, solar or home-automation product.
how: On Today, drag the scrubber or press Play the day: sunrise, noon, sunset and night roll past and the running routines appear as chips
Press Now to return to the live house; the windows follow the real lights
Flip the sun and moon switch: the sky sweeps to noon or to night and the glass turns milky or smoked
In Routines, drag a coloured block along the day, or focus it and use the arrow keys; add, edit, pause, run or delete routines
Switch lights in Rooms, turn the cooling dial in Climate and read the seven-day forecast
Compare solar made with house use, keep the battery for the night, and lock the gate in Security
